item.title: Biden Asks Why Trump Didn't Just Bomb Ayatollah In the Leg
item.description: DOVER, DE — In the wake of the highly successful decapitation of Iran's tyrannical dictatorship, former American president Joe Biden asked why Trump didn't just bomb the Ayatollah in the leg.

item.title: Economists Announce Global Economic System Depends Entirely On Like Maybe Two Guys At Nvidia Who Understand How Computers Work
item.description: U.S. — American economists warned the public on Tuesday that the entire global economic system depends entirely on "like two or three guys" at Nvidia who understand how computers work.

item.title: Global Leaders Warn That If WW3 Doesn't End Soon, It Could Disrupt Taylor Swift's Wedding
item.description: WORLD — World leaders pleaded with Israel and the United States to stop attacking Iran this week in an emergency meeting of the United Nations Security Council, warning that if World War III doesn't end soon, it would likely distract from Taylor Swift's wedding.

item.title: New Reusable Water Bottle Makes You Sign In To Google
item.description: U.S. — According to sources, a new reusable water bottle now requires the user to sign into their Google account in order to open it.

item.title: Lame Local Church Doesn't Even Have An App
item.description: WACO, TX — According to sources, a lame local church doesn't even have its own app.

item.title: Pentecostal Wins At Scrabble Again By Spelling All Words In Tongues
item.description: FALLON, NV — Local Pentecostal Christian Glenn Fuller reportedly beat all his friends at Scrabble yet again thanks to his miraculous ability to spell out all words in tongues.
